answer.location_description: Top-right corner of the image, roughly the top 3–4 rows and columns ~15–22, well outside the nodule at the image centre.
answer.shortcut_type: Bright artifact or marker patch in the top-right corner, unrelated to nodule anatomy
answer.mechanism: Brightness in the top-right corner suppresses the malignant-leaning units and excites the benign-leaning units, so both effects push the logit negative. The malignant-leaning units are the 'large nodule' units 10, 16, 19, 23, 30 and 12, which have a negative centre and a positive ring at radius 3–5. In their outer field they carry strong, spatially coherent negative weights only in the top-right corner. The benign-leaning units are the 'small compact nodule' units 0, 8, 25, 5, 31, 13 and 14 (positive centre, negative ring), which carry positive weights in that same corner. Unit 16 feeds the output's malignant pathway strongly, via u4, u8 and u15, and through negative weights onto u0, u9 and u12, which carry negative output weights. Unit 0 feeds the benign pathway (u4 -71, u8 -90, u15 -96, u0 +31, u9 +36).
answer.evidence: Unit 10, rows 0–2, cols 15–21: -41 -32 -40 -17 -24 -38 -52 / -22 -27 -35 -23 -39 -37 / -38 -45 -16 -9 -33 -45. Unit 16, same region: -39 -37 -40 -13 -23 -56 -45 and r2: -39 -30 -9 -30 -55 -37. Unit 19, rows 0–2, cols 12–23: uniformly -35 to -72. Unit 23, rows 0–2, cols 15–23: -31 to -60. Units 12 and 30 have milder negatives (-19 to -38) in the same place. None of these units show comparable negatives in the other three corners (the top-left is near zero or positive), so the pattern is not radially symmetric like the nodule detectors. The benign-side units carry positive weights here instead: unit 0 r0 c20–21 = 33, 43 and r2–r3 c20 = 41, 44; unit 8 r0–r4 c19–20 = 26/15, 40/41, 49, 40; unit 25 r0 c20 = 41; unit 31 r0 c20–21 = 27, 25. Rough contribution tracing: unit 16 to output is strongly positive (malignant), and unit 0 to output is strongly negative (benign).
answer.main_feature: Nodule size and shape at the image centre. Center-surround units (bright compact centre, dark ring at radius ~3–4) push toward benign. Ring units (negative centre weights, positive surround, responding to larger or irregular bright extent around the centre) push toward malignant.
